what_happened: The operator corrected Athena's reading of a request to speed up the test suite. An earlier attempt had cut the test check from about 12 to 7.8 minutes (suite run about 405 s). The corrected reading says to keep that approach. It also allows behavior-preserving production changes, each with a test: a per-process memo in the secret scanner (crates/athena-gate/src/secrets.rs) and a shorter poll schedule in run_check (crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs). Both files become deliverables. The target is a full `cargo test --locked` under 7 minutes on the job's machine, with per-binary before and after numbers in docs/decisions.md. Earlier constraints stay: no test removed, weakened or filtered; nextest rejected.
cause: Athena builds a reading from the request text alone. It has no step that pulls in the previous attempt's measured outcome, the approach that worked, and the files it touched. It also does not ask what scope a performance goal needs. A test-speed goal that can only be met by behavior-preserving production changes was read as tests-only, so the deliverable list was too narrow and the target was not a measured number.
prevention: When a job retries or follows an earlier attempt, the reading stage must take a structured summary of that attempt as input. The summary covers the measured result, the approach to keep, the files changed, and the corrections already given. The reading must list each of these as keep, change or drop. For a performance goal, the reading must state a numeric target, the measurement method and place, and whether behavior-preserving production changes are allowed. If they are, the reading must name the files as deliverables and require a test for each change. The critic rejects a reading that omits any of these.
proposed_request: Cut the full `cargo test --locked` run to under 7 minutes on the job's machine. Keep the approach from the last attempt, which took Athena's test check from about 12 to 7.8 minutes (suite about 405 s), and keep its changes. Behavior-preserving production changes are allowed, and each needs a test proving behavior is unchanged: (1) a memo of scan results for identical text within one process in crates/athena-gate/src/secrets.rs; (2) a shorter poll schedule in run_check in crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs. Both files are deliverables. Do not remove, weaken or filter any test. Do not use nextest; record its measurement as the reason it was rejected. Measure the full run and each test binary before and after on the job's machine. Report the figures in docs/decisions.md. Acceptance: the full `cargo test --locked` passes in under 7 minutes; the production changes each have a test; docs/decisions.md holds the per-binary before and after figures.
